title: Decision: Attendance and Participation by Non-Signatory States at the Thirtieth Session of the Conference of the States Parties
text:
CS-2025-5378(E) distributed 26/11/2025 
*CS-2025-5378.E* 
 
 
OPCW 
Conference of the States Parties 
Thirtieth Session 
24 – 28 November 2025 
C-30/DEC.1 
24 November 2025 
Original: ENGLISH 
DECISION 
ATTENDANCE AND PARTICIPATION BY NON-SIGNATORY STATES AT THE 
THIRTIETH SESSION OF THE CONFERENCE OF THE STATES PARTIES 
 
The Conference of the States Parties, 
 
Bearing in mind Rule 30 of its Rules of Procedure, 
 
Hereby: 
 
Extends observer status to South Sudan—a State that has neither signed the Chemical 
Weapons Convention nor acceded to it—at the Thirtieth Session of the Conference of the States 
Parties.
